title: Great app for people that need music to perform
body: If you have difficulty to focus, relax, meditate or sleep this something for you. There is a free version which limits the duration one can listen or a year/ lifetime subscription. This is even better than the focus playlist on Spotify. It features all unique tracks and music. No vocals whatsoever which makes you focus even better. Worth the investment!

title: Fantastic App!
body: Love this app! I've had difficulty focusing on my tasks and projects, and distractions have been my worst nightmare. I couldn't believe that I could work 2 hrs straight without opening Facebook when listening to the Focus Session!
